units.titles: Insufficient verification of staking account in Unstake struct
units.known_address_notes: Hexens (Mar 2025) reviewed the Mintify Staking Solana program (unstake.rs, staking.rs, mint_controller, off-chain co-signed orders). No program id, deployment or repo is given; docs.mintify.xyz is broken (Cloudflare error 1014) and mintify.xyz exposes no address. No Solana program id resolved; the 'MINT' tokens on Solana are unrelated pump.fun issues.

units.titles: Price threshold for price invalidity is prone to manipulation and might lead to full loss of users funds in case of a breakdown of a market or an asset
units.known_address_notes: Oak Security audit (2023-01-20) of Ninja v1.0, a CosmWasm perp/volatility protocol on Injective; scope repo https://github.com/ninja-finance/ninja-contracts (contract.rs/config.rs/vault/subscriptions) is now 404/private. No code_id or inj1... contract address is published in the report or retainable docs, so no instance could be verified on Injective.

units.titles: _mint() can mint more than the limit
units.known_address_notes: Cantina review (May 2025) of Odx: ODXOracle (Chainlink latestRoundData + L2 sequencer uptime), Controller, NFT mint/request flow, merchant front-running. Report describes ODX as 'the first permissionless perpetual protocol with custom zkEVM App-chain'; no repo, no chain id, no addresses. ODX chain is not covered by Etherscan V2/DefiLlama listings; no deployment could be traced.
